verdict.rationale: Entra ID is exposed through the documented Microsoft Graph API, which has a single public endpoint and documented operations such as listing user objects, so programmatic control is the product's own capability. The evidence shows only a narrow slice of that surface (user reads), not API control of conditional access, lifecycle workflows, or entitlement management, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for core admin operations beyond user listing (conditional access, governance, app management), a discoverable OpenAPI/spec for the Entra surface, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Entra via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Microsoft Graph API offers a single endpoint, https://graph.microsoft.com, to provide access to rich, people-centric data and insights in the Microsoft cloud, including Microsoft 365, Windows, and Enterprise Mobility + Security.
